abilities.desc_zh: 重击喷出猛烈烈焰火海，击退敌人并施加持续燃烧。自身完全免疫燃烧效果。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy attacks spray roaring flame walls that push foes back and apply Burn. Hotlink is completely immune to Burn.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击命中 100% 概率施加燃烧减益，造成攻击力 60% 的伤害，持续 6 秒。当对手处于燃烧状态时，热链接的近战攻击命中 100% 刷新该燃烧减益的持续时间，且额外造成 25% 的近战物理伤害。热链接自身受到流血减益影响时，受到的流血伤害降低 30%。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: 100% chance to inflict Burn, dealing 60% Attack as heat damage over 6s. While the opponent is Burning, Hotlink's Melee hits 100% refresh the Burn duration and deal +25% bonus Melee Damage. Reduces incoming Bleed damage by 30% while suffering from Bleed Debuffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 当生命值低于 50% 时触发：获得持续 6 秒的不可阻挡增益；且在此期间每次近战攻击命中处于燃烧状态的敌人时，额外获得一层 15% 的近战增益，持续 5 秒（上限 3 层）。
abilities.desc_en: When Health drops below 50%: gains Unstoppable for 6s. Melee hits landed on Burning opponents grant a 15% Melee Buff for 5s (Max Stacks: 3).

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击命中 100% 概率施加燃烧减益，造成攻击力 50% 的伤害，持续 5 秒；技能结束后自身获得一层 20% 的近战增益，持续 6 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict Burn dealing 50% Attack over 5s; grants a 20% Melee Buff for 6s after the Special ends.

abilities.desc_zh: 每一击有 85% 概率施加燃烧减益，造成攻击力 70% 的伤害，持续 6 秒；并有 50% 概率造成眩晕，持续 1.5 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Each hit has an 85% chance to inflict Burn dealing 70% Attack over 6s; 50% chance to inflict Stun for 1.5s.

abilities.desc_zh: 最后一击 100% 概率施加燃烧减益，造成攻击力 100% 的伤害，持续 8 秒；技能结束后获得一层 30% 的护甲增益，持续 8 秒，以及持续 4 秒的不可阻挡增益。
abilities.desc_en: Last hit: 100% chance to inflict Burn dealing 100% Attack over 8s; grants a 30% Armor Buff for 8s and Unstoppable for 4s after the Special ends.

abilities.desc_zh: 与千斤顶、声波同队时，火焰伤害提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Fire Damage when teamed with Wheeljack or Soundwave.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，攻击力提升 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Attack Rating when paired with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 护甲。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Armor.
